definition.window_error: source-weighted relative L1 difference between direct and composed UOT transfer kernels
definition.entropy_fraction: transported-mass-weighted conditional row entropy divided by log(min(kernel_topk, n_pixels))
definition.conditional_spread_rms: transported-mass-weighted RMS destination spread about each row barycenter on the [0,1]^2 grid
definition.output_mass_ratio: kernel output mass divided by source image mass
definition.useful_flag: heuristic diagnostic flag; it does not alter G_l
